facts.material: polyamide (PA6-imide) thermoplastic, no reinforcement or filler
facts.function: feedstock for material extrusion additive manufacturing
facts.form: extruded solid round monofilament, 1.75 mm diameter, on spools

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 3916 monofilament of which any cross-sectional dimension exceeds 1 mm, of plastics; 1.75 mm exceeds 1 mm so textile heading 5404 (max 1 mm) does not apply

rejected_alternatives.reason: textile monofilament must not exceed 1 mm in cross-section

classification.rationale: Solid round polyamide monofilament of 1.75 mm falls in heading 3916 and, being neither ethylene, vinyl chloride nor acrylic, in other plastics, monofilament line. Spools are for dispensing only and do not change classification.
